timeline.tweet: So unbelievably sad to hear that... but its not the first time or the last.

I didn’t get diagnosed with PPD but then again I might have and not known it because I was diagnosed with depression anxiety and PTSD 3years later. I have used the hotline but there was 1 day I didn’t but thankfully a friend came over before anything happened.

I can only say that having OCD helps me w/my anxiety because I schedule &make lists more than most but staying organized has helped me get thru and be able to carve out me time amidst work school friend&family. Each group has their own color in the calendar- so visually helpful.
